document.abstract: The proper control of the intensity of the lighting in a theater is essential to the comfort and safety of the audience. The theater dimmer is the device which provides means of adjusting these intensities as required by the season of the year or the time of day. Of the various types of theater dimmers available, the autotransformer dimmer provides the most efficient and desirable unit for the small neighborhood theater. Units of large capacity are available, which will operate at high efficiency and low maintenance cost.
